subject.title: Text overlap rendering bug in Telegram inline keyboard messages (macOS desktop app)

question: Should this Telegram macOS rendering bug be solved by a targeted `/model` and `/commands` rendering repair, or by accepting a broader Telegram render/parse-mode config surface?
rationale: The bug is concrete, but the open candidate PRs split between an adjacent rich-heading change and a new account-wide raw-render config, and repository policy sets a high bar for new config surfaces.

options.title: Target the command/model paths
options.body: Retarget the fix to the emitted `/model` and `/commands` Telegram messages and require focused native Desktop proof before closing this issue.

options.title: Complete a render-mode config
options.body: Keep the config approach only if maintainers want that product surface and it is wired through all Telegram send, reply, edit, metadata, docs, and test paths.

options.title: Hold behind broader parse-mode design
options.body: Defer this issue to the broader parse/text-mode design only if maintainers decide the macOS overlap should not receive a narrow targeted fix.

recommendation.title: Target the command/model paths
recommendation.body: Retarget the fix to the emitted `/model` and `/commands` Telegram messages and require focused native Desktop proof before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the recent Telegram formatting compatibility work and has prior review context on the broader parse/text-mode config decision.
